# Lektori Libra

> Professional proofreading, copy editing and substantive editing (Serbian: lektura, korektura, redaktura) in Serbian, English and 30 other languages, run by philologist Ana Todorović-Radetić since 2016. Prices from €1.99 per standard page (1,800 characters with spaces). Free two-page sample edit. NDA signed on request before receiving documents. Based in Belgrade, Serbia; works fully online for clients worldwide.

Lektori Libra (formerly also "Lektura Libra") is the proofreading brand of the Prevodioci Libra translation agency (https://www.prevodioci.co.rs/). It has worked with more than 1000 clients, including the Government of the Republic of Serbia, Serbian ministries, the Serbian Chamber of Commerce, the Novak Djokovic Foundation and faculties of the University of Belgrade.

Key facts:

- Services: proofreading and copy editing (lektura i korektura), substantive editing (redaktura), editing of AI-generated or AI-translated text, print preparation.
- Texts: books and manuscripts, poetry, bachelor's/master's theses and doctoral dissertations, academic and specialist papers (law, medicine, economics, IT, engineering), business documents, contracts, websites, ads, subtitles, PowerPoint and Excel files.
- Method: three-pass editing (typos and formatting → spelling and grammar → style), plus a final check. Delivered in Word with Track Changes plus a clean version.
- Prices per standard page: Serbian €1.99–7, English €4.99–9, other languages €6–15. Invoiced in RSD at the National Bank of Serbia middle rate; not VAT-registered.
- Turnaround: short texts often the same day; agreed deadlines are always met.
- Confidentiality: all texts confidential; NDA signed before receiving documents on request (own or client's template).
- Contact: +381 65 36 70 320, prevodiocibg@gmail.com, contact form with attachments on the website (up to 3 files, 10 MB).
- Legal entity: Ana Todorović Radetić preduzetnik Prevodilačka agencija Prevodioci Libra Dimitrovgrad, Balkanska 120, 18320 Dimitrovgrad, Serbia; tax ID (PIB) 109642260; reg. no. (MB) 64324861.

About Ana Todorović-Radetić: graduate in English language and literature (Faculty of Philosophy, Niš), translator, former English teacher, IELTS Academic (British Council). Author of the novel "Cvetovi agave" (Prometej, 2022) and the poetry collection "Kada sam bila ptica" (Prometej, 2024). Speaks Serbian, English, Russian and Bulgarian.

## FAQ (English)

### What does proofreading and copy editing include?

A thorough, systematic review of your material, so the final text is clear, readable and linguistically correct:

- **formatting** – page layout, margins, line spacing, font, headings and subheadings;
- **typos** – spelling slips and stray spaces;
- **orthography** – punctuation, capitalisation, abbreviations, compound words, transcription of foreign names;
- **grammar** – agreement (person, gender, number and case) and verb patterns;
- **syntax** – conjunctions, punctuation in complex sentences, word order and clarity;
- **vocabulary and style** – redundancy, repetition and unidiomatic expressions.

### What is the difference between copy editing and proofreading?

The Serbian word lektura comes from the Latin legere – to read. A copy editor works deep in the text: spelling, grammar, style and meaning. Proofreading (Serbian korektura, from corrigere – to correct) is the final polish after editing and typesetting: removing remaining typos, double spaces, incorrect hyphenation and technical slips.

Today the two are usually combined into a single service, as that is the only way to get a fully finished text.

### Do you proofread texts in foreign languages?

Of course. We proofread every language we translate into and from – some thirty, including English, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Bulgarian, Macedonian, Slovenian, Czech, Romanian and Arabic. If needed, we translate your text first and then proofread the translation.

### Do you proofread texts written in dialect?

Yes. Dialects have no standardised spelling rules, so besides fixing slips and punctuation, the editor makes sure characteristic expressions are written consistently. With these texts, close communication with the author is especially important.

### What kinds of texts do you proofread?

No limits: novels, short stories, poetry, plays, diaries and travel writing; essays, bachelor’s and master’s theses, doctoral dissertations, articles and studies; brochures, manuals, textbooks and guides; blogs, websites, ads and subtitles. We also proofread PowerPoint presentations and Excel spreadsheets.

### Do you proofread specialist texts?

Yes – law, economics and marketing, medicine and pharmacy, computing, mechanical and civil engineering, ecology, tourism, the arts, sport and many other fields. Specialist texts are assigned to editors who specialise in that field.

### How can I see what was changed?

We work in Word with Track Changes switched on, so every correction is highlighted and clearly marked. You receive two versions: one with visible changes and a “clean” version with all changes accepted, ready for further work or publication.

### Will proofreading change my style?

No. The editor removes redundancy and obvious repetition, splits overlong sentences and fixes unclear constructions, but doesn’t “go too far” or spoil your authentic style – which matters especially with literary texts. If you need deeper work on structure and style, that is **substantive editing**, which we always do in consultation with the author.

### Is one read-through enough?

Never. The first pass is for typos and formatting, the second for spelling and grammar, the third for style. Each pass also catches anything missed before, and at the end we review the final version with all changes accepted once more.

### Does proofreading include preparing the text for print?

The editor also formats the text (layout, margins, line spacing, font, headings, alignment), so the final version is print-ready. For publications with photos and complex layouts we work with graphic designers, and for web content with SEO specialists.

### How do I send my text, and in what format?

The easiest way is by email, to prevodiocibg@gmail.com. We usually receive Word documents, but we also work on PowerPoint presentations, Excel spreadsheets and other formats. We return the edited text by email by the agreed deadline.

### Do you sign a non-disclosure agreement (NDA)?

Yes. If required, **we sign a non-disclosure agreement (NDA) before receiving your document**, so your text is protected before we even open it. We can sign our standard agreement or one prepared by your company or legal team.

The NDA binds every editor and collaborator working on the project. We use your texts only for the agreed job, keep them no longer than agreed and delete them once the work is done. This is standard practice for unpublished manuscripts, theses before their defence, legal, business and tender documents, and medical records.

### How long does proofreading take?

It depends on length, content, complexity and how much editing is needed. Shorter texts are often ready the same day; for longer material we give a precise estimate – and we always meet the agreed deadline.

### Do you issue invoices?

Yes. Companies and sole traders receive an invoice, and individuals a fiscal receipt, which we can send electronically together with the edited text.

## Pitanja i odgovori (srpski)

### Šta obuhvata lektura i korektura teksta?

Detaljan i sistematičan pregled materijala, sa ciljem da finalni tekst bude pregledan, jasan i jezički korektan:

- **tehnička uređenost** – format stranica, margine, prored, font, naslovi i podnaslovi;
- **greške u kucanju** – slovne greške i nepotrebne beline;
- **pravopis** – interpunkcija, veliko i malo slovo, skraćenice, spojeno i odvojeno pisanje, transkripcija;
- **gramatika** – kongruencija (slaganje u licu, rodu, broju i padežu) i rekcija glagola;
- **sintaksa** – veznici, interpunkcija u složenim rečenicama, inverzija i jasnoća konstrukcija;
- **leksika i stil** – pleonazmi, ponavljanja, izrazi koji nisu u duhu jezika.

### Koja je razlika između lekture i korekture?

Naziv lektura potiče od latinskog „legere“ – čitati. Lektor se dubinski bavi tekstom: pravopisom, gramatikom, stilom i smislom napisanog. Korektura (od „corrigere“ – ispraviti) je završno uređenje nakon lekture i prelamanja: uklanjanje preostalih slovnih grešaka, višestrukih razmaka, pogrešnog prenošenja reči u novi red i tehničkih propusta.

Danas se najčešće rade kao objedinjena usluga, jer se samo tako postiže potpuno spreman tekst.

### Da li lektorišete tekstove na stranim jezicima?

Naravno. Lekturu nudimo za sve jezike na koje i sa kojih prevodimo – tridesetak njih, među kojima su engleski, nemački, francuski, italijanski, španski, portugalski, ruski, bugarski, makedonski, slovenački, češki, rumunski i arapski. Po potrebi tekst najpre prevodimo, a zatim lektorišemo i prevod.

### Da li lektorišete tekstove pisane na dijalektu?

Da. Dijalekti nemaju standardizovana pravopisna pravila, pa lektor, pored uklanjanja omaški i uređivanja interpunkcije, uvodi doslednost u pisanju karakterističnih izraza. Kod ovakvih tekstova posebno nam je važna komunikacija sa autorom.

### Koje vrste tekstova lektorišete?

Bez ograničenja: romane, priče, poeziju, drame, dnevnike i putopise; seminarske, diplomske i master radove, doktorske disertacije, članke i studije; brošure, uputstva, udžbenike i priručnike; blogove, sajtove, oglase, reklame i titlove. Lektorišemo i PowerPoint prezentacije i Excel tabele.

### Da li lektorišete stručne tekstove?

Da – iz prava, ekonomije i marketinga, medicine i farmacije, računarstva, mašinstva i građevinarstva, ekologije, turizma, umetnosti, sporta i mnogih drugih oblasti. Stručne tekstove poveravamo lektorima specijalizovanim za datu oblast.

### Kako mogu da vidim šta je izmenjeno?

Lekturu radimo u Wordu sa uključenom opcijom Track Changes, pa je svaka ispravka istaknuta i jasno označena. Dobijate dve verzije: sa vidljivim izmenama i „čistu“ verziju sa prihvaćenim izmenama, spremnu za dalju obradu ili objavljivanje.

### Da li će lektura promeniti moj stil?

Ne. Lektor uklanja pleonazme i upadljiva ponavljanja, deli preduge rečenice i menja nejasne konstrukcije, ali ne „ide predaleko“ i ne narušava autentičan stil – što je posebno važno kod književnih tekstova. Ako vam je potrebna dublja obrada strukture i stila, to je **redaktura**, koju radimo uz konsultacije sa autorom.

### Da li je jedno čitanje dovoljno?

Nikada. Prvo čitanje posvećeno je korekturi i tehničkom uređenju, drugo pravopisu i gramatici, a treće stilu. U svakom narednom čitanju hvatamo i ono što je eventualno promaklo, a na kraju još jednom pregledamo konačnu verziju sa prihvaćenim izmenama.

### Da li lektura uključuje pripremu za štampu?

Lektor tehnički uređuje tekst (format, margine, prored, font, naslovi, poravnanje), pa je finalna verzija spremna za štampu. Za publikacije sa fotografijama i složenim prelomom sarađujemo sa grafičkim dizajnerima, a za tekstove namenjene sajtovima i sa SEO stručnjacima.

### Kako šaljem tekst i u kom formatu?

Najjednostavnije je imejlom, na prevodiocibg@gmail.com. Najčešće dobijamo Word dokumente, ali lektorišemo i PowerPoint prezentacije, Excel tabele i druge formate. Lektorisan tekst vraćamo imejlom u dogovorenom roku.

### Da li potpisujete ugovor o poverljivosti (NDA)?

Da. Ukoliko je potrebno, **ugovor o poverljivosti (NDA) potpisujemo pre preuzimanja dokumenta**, tako da je vaš tekst zaštićen i pre nego što ga otvorimo. Možemo potpisati naš standardni ugovor ili ugovor koji pripremi vaša kompanija, odnosno pravna služba.

NDA obavezuje sve lektore i saradnike angažovane na projektu. Tekstove koristimo isključivo za ugovoreni posao, ne čuvamo ih duže nego što je dogovoreno i po završetku ih brišemo. Ovakva praksa je uobičajena kod rukopisa pre objavljivanja, naučnih radova pre odbrane, pravne, poslovne i tenderske dokumentacije, kao i medicinske dokumentacije.

### Koliko traje lektura?

Zavisi od obima, sadržaja, stručnosti i količine potrebnih intervencija. Kraći tekstovi često su gotovi istog dana, a za obimnije materijale dajemo preciznu procenu – i dogovoreni rok uvek poštujemo.

### Da li izdajete račun?

Da. Pravnim licima i preduzetnicima izdajemo račun, a fizičkim licima fiskalni račun, koji možemo dostaviti i elektronski, zajedno sa lektorisanim tekstom.
